display_long_description:
[media]
# 💣 Unleash the Explosive Path

Bring chaos to the club with the new **Explosive weapon branch**.

Start with the **Sticky Grenade**, upgrade to the devastating **Cluster Launcher**, and finish with the destructive **Detonation Core 💥**. Bigger blasts, wider damage, and more ways to control the fight.

[media]

When subtlety isn't an option, explosives get the job done.

# 💰 Earn Coins. Get Stronger. 🪙

Every fight moves you forward. Earn coins for **every kill 🥊**, boost your rewards with **finisher takedowns**, and secure bonuses by placing in the **Top 3 🏆**.

Climb the weekly leaderboard for the biggest payouts and turn every match into progress.

# 🥊 Finish Strong

Winning isn't just about knocking someone out — it's about how you end it.

**Finishers give you full control over the final moment**, turning every victory into a decisive, visible, player-driven outcome.

[media]

**💥 Brain Blaster**
Fast. Clean. Final.

[media]

**😈 Devil's Hand**
Close-range. Personal. Unforgiving.

[media]

**🩸 Gut Ripper**
Aggressive. Brutal. Impossible to ignore.

Every fight ends in front of others.
**How you finish defines how you're remembered.**

# Club Fight

Step into a nightclub after midnight, where real players collide and every match ends with a decisive final strike 👊

No combos to memorize. No scripted outcomes. Just your timing, your positioning, and your nerve.

🔥 **Fast, physical, unpredictable fights.**

💥 **Explosive weapons.**

🔴🔵 **Squad-based battles.**

💬 Find players, improve faster, and stay in the loop:
**https://discord.gg/aNgksnfvGN**"
